sw_revenue_misattribution.explanation: SWTrancheController recorded all farm-wide market sales of products included in the admitted SW portfolio (STRAWBERRY and MELON). Since the core NW/NE farm already grew large cohorts of strawberries and melons, core farm harvests were mistakenly attributed to the 8 SW tiles.

seed_cost_misaccounting.explanation: MacroPlanner drew seeds from existing shed inventory rather than placing new BUY_SEED orders. While direct cash outflow at planting was .00, 8 seed units (4 strawberries at  and 4 melons at ) worth  were consumed.

whole_farm_decomposition_134_purchases.methodological_note: Decomposition categorizes all figures as Measured (verifiable engine cash movements), Estimated (physical yield bounds, price schedules, and historical control comparisons), or Unattributed Residual to prevent speculative precision.

aggregate_inventory_fungibility_limits.fungibility_point: Once harvested crops enter worker backpacks and are deposited into the central shed, origin quadrant tags are erased by the engine environment.
aggregate_inventory_fungibility_limits.conservation_proof: SW quadrant is physically constrained to 8 tiles. Maximum strawberry yield over days 10-30 is 16 units; maximum melon yield is 16 units. Theoretical maximum gross revenue cannot exceed ,500 under perfect pricing.
